per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have validation and conflict detection mechanisms to prevent scheduling mistakes, including visual cues and undo/confirmation for destructive actions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle routine tasks (CRUD, viewing lists) in less than five seconds and full schedule generation in thirty seconds or less.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a monthly availability target of 95%, allowing for planned maintenance but not unexpected downtime.

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support five years of historical data for accreditation, with older data archived in a read-only, slower storage format.
